Chapter 552 - 552 Dinner; Shopping!

Chapter 552 - 552 Dinner; Shopping!

552 Dinner; Shopping!

Compared to some factories and companies, Waffle Corporation could be considered a large company with a total asset of more than 100 million yuan.

However, there was no comparison between Waffle Corporation and Liu Pharmaceuticals!

The difference was between heaven and earth!

Although Liu Yuhang was normally a joker, he did not put on any airs.

However, he was definitely not a soft-hearted person.

Liu Yuhang ignored Tan Jiayou’s pleas as if he had not heard them.

Lin Fan looked at the passersby around him. They seemed to be looking at him curiously because of Tan Jiayou’s voice. He frowned and said, “It’s almost time for dinner. Let’s go eat something first.

“Yuhang, are there any good places?”

Liu Yuhang immediately said, “Brother Lin Fan, you’ve asked the right person! I’ll make the arrangements for lunch. What do you think?”

“I don’t have to worry about it and I can eat delicious food for free. Of course, that’s great!” Lin Fan smiled.

Liu Yuhang was also very happy. “Then leave it to me!”

“Brother Lin Fan, there’s only one seat in my car. I’ll arrange for another car to come over.”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No need. My car is over there. You can lead the way.”

As he spoke, he took out his car keys and pressed them lightly.

Not far away, the tall and cool Cullinan immediately lit up.

Then, Lin Fan said to Li Xinyue, “Xinyue, are you free in the afternoon? Do you want to eat together?”

Eating with Brother Lin Fan?

This was something she had always dreamed of!

Li Xinyue did not hesitate and immediately nodded. “I’m free!”

Wang Tong saw Lin Fan and Liu Yuhang reprimanding Tan Jiayou like he was their grandson.

Furthermore, Liu Yuhang was driving a Lamborghini while Lin Fan was driving a Cullinan…

At this moment, no matter how stupid she was, she knew that they were both very impressive rich young masters.

Wang Tong could not help but say, “Uhh… Can I go with you?”

As she spoke, she put on a pitiful look, looking like an injured rabbit.

Lin Fan did not say anything and looked at Li Xinyue.

“No,” Li Xinyue said directly.

After saying that, she got into Lin Fan’s Cullinan.

Li Xinyue and Wang Tong had only been friends for a week.

They were not familiar with each other at all.

In the dormitory, Wang Tong had been praising Tan Jiayou in front of Li Xinyue, trying to matchmake the two of them. This had already made Li Xinyue a little unhappy.

However, she did not show it and just rejected Wang Tong’s request directly.

Today, after Li Xinyue rejected her outright, Wang Tong found an excuse to ask her out and even created a chance encounter between her and Tan Jiayou.

This made Li Xinyue feel disgusted.

In Li Xinyue’s mind, she had already blacklisted Wang Tong.

At this moment, how could he agree to let her join them for their meal?

Lin Fan heard her reply and did not stop. He stepped on the accelerator and followed the Lamborghini.

A super sports car and a top-notch SUV… One after the other, they formed a beautiful scenery on the wide street, attracting the attention of many passersby.

Not long after, the three of them arrived at a restaurant called Big Pufferfish.

Just as they reached the entrance of the restaurant, an alluring fragrance filled the air, making people feel like their appetite was whetted.

Li Xinyue was a little confused. “Pufferfish? Can we eat pufferfish? Isn’t it poisonous?”

Lin Fan said, “Pufferfish are indeed poisonous. However, only the ovaries, liver, kidneys, blood, eyes, gills, skin, and other parts of the pufferfish are poisonous. Among them, the ovaries and liver contain fatal poison.

“Therefore, when cooking pufferfish, as long as you let an experienced chef completely remove these parts, especially the ovaries and liver, you can eat without worry.”

His answer was very indifferent.

In fact, these… only applied to ordinary people.

If it was Lin Fan, even if the ovaries and liver were not removed, it would not matter.

That was because Lin Fan was already immune to all poisons.

Hearing Lin Fan’s reply, Li Xinyue’s face was filled with infatuation.

Erudite and talented!

It was as if nothing could stop Brother Lin Fan!

He was so handsome!

“As expected of Brother Lin Fan!” Liu Yuhang exclaimed. “You even know all this! It seems like… you’ve already eaten pufferfish! I thought of letting you have a taste today…”

Lin Fan smiled. “I only saw this from other places. Today is my first time eating pufferfish.”

Lin Fan’s words could be said to be half true.

This was because his knowledge about pufferfish was not obtained from other sources.

It was something he learned from the system when he obtained Master Chef Experience.

However, Lin Fan had never eaten pufferfish before.

Liu Yuhang laughed and said, “Then it seems that I brought you to the right place.”

After a while, a large pot of fragrant pufferfish soup was served.

As the soup boiled, Liu Yuhang said, “Brother Lin Fan, Sister Xinyue, you can try the soup first. It’s very sweet and delicious.”

The two of them took a sip of the soup.

Li Xinyue’s pretty face revealed a look of enjoyment that was difficult to hide.

Lin Fan said, “It’s delicious.”

Liu Yuhang was even happier. “Try the pufferfish meat,” he said.

It melted in one’s mouth, fresh and sweet!

Li Xinyue could not help but exclaim, “It’s delicious!”

Lin Fan nodded his head.

The three of them were very happy and satisfied with the meal.

It was rare for Liu Yuhang to meet Lin Fan, so he really wanted to talk to him.

However, he knew that now was not the time. He might even disturb Lin Fan and Li Xinyue’s time together.

After lunch, Liu Yuhang found an excuse and left early.

“Xinyue, have you been to Jiangbei?” Lin Fan asked.

“Not yet.” Li Xinyue shook her head.

In fact, this was also the reason why Wang Tong had asked her out today.

Lin Fan said, “Then I’ll bring you around so that you can digest your food better.”

“Alright.” Li Xinyue said happily.

In her heart, as long as she was with Lin Fan, she was willing to do anything.

Lin Fan first brought Li Xinyue to the famous lake in Jiangbei to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

Then, he brought her to M Mall.

When he passed by the Cartier store, he bought a necklace for Li Xinyue under the recommendation of the salesperson.

After all, even Liu Yuhang had given her a gift.

How could Lin Fan, her senior, not give her a gift?

Today, Li Xinyue had a sweet smile on her face almost all the time. She was extremely happy.

It was not because she got to see the beautiful scenery of Jiangbei, nor was it because she could experience the bustling city.

It was because she met Lin Fan, had a meal with him, and received a gift from him!
